svg.aria-label: Vishal V portfolio tour: home, what I can do, how I think, cybersecurity, AI, agan, Sydra OS, contact

g.text: I build Linux systems and security tools,
and I’m the creator of Sydra OS. I think in
layers, question defaults and learn by building.
Things I can build for you or with you.
I ask why it is built this
way, then test a better one.
Each habit shows up in what
Cybersecurity decides how far we can trust
software and AI, so I treat it as a core craft.
Think like an attacker to defend better
Harden systems: secure defaults, easy recovery
Understand the human side of breaches
Build security tools and a small pentesting model
Guard AI itself as agents gain power
I use AI as a builder’s partner,
and I’m learning to build it too.
AI helps defenders, security keeps AI in check
One common intelligence for every maker,
Knowledge from the internet, skills in a small local model.
Profiles, same skills on every size
people who build and play games.
Open to roles and conversations about Linux
customization, local AI, agent tooling and security.
